name: MASArena
summary: Modular arena for benchmarking single- and multi-agent LLM systems, with pluggable agents/tools/datasets/evaluators.

name: AgentBench
summary: Comprehensive multi-environment benchmark for evaluating LLMs as agents, including a multi-agent (Avalon social-deduction) task category.

name: OSWorld
summary: Benchmark platform providing real computer environments (real OS, real apps) for evaluating multimodal computer-use agents on open-ended tasks.

name: OpenUnlearning
summary: Extensible framework unifying LLM unlearning evaluation across the TOFU/MUSE/WMDP benchmarks, 12+ unlearning methods, and 10+ evaluation metrics.

name: LLM Attributor
summary: Interactive tool to visualize and attribute an LLM's generated text back to specific training data points.

name: AI Incident Database
summary: Open, taxonomy-classified database of documented real-world AI incidents spanning many sectors and risk types.

name: CloakLLM
summary: Open-source PII protection middleware for LLM prompts: reversible tokenization, per-entity HMAC-SHA256 hashing for cross-request correlation without storing PII, and cryptographically signed tamper-evident audit logs.
